definitions.explanation: The state of being unnamed or unidentified. Used as a noun or as a modifier (匿名の) to describe something done without revealing one's name.

examples.japanese: {匿名|とくめい}で{投稿|とうこう}する。
{匿名|とくめい}の{通報|つうほう}があり、{警察|けいさつ}が{動|うご}いた。
examples.english: There was an anonymous tip, and the police took action.

examples.japanese: インターネットでは{匿名|とくめい}で{発言|はつげん}できるため、{無責任|むせきにん}なコメントが{増|ふ}えやすい。
examples.english: Because one can speak anonymously on the internet, irresponsible comments tend to increase.

notes:
Composed of {匿|とく} (conceal) + {名|めい} (name). Functions as both a noun and a no-adjective ({匿名|とくめい}の〜).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {匿名|とくめい}で: anonymously
- {匿名|とくめい}の{通報|つうほう}: anonymous tip/report
- {匿名|とくめい}{掲示板|けいじばん}: anonymous message board
- {匿名|とくめい}の{寄付|きふ}: anonymous donation
- {匿名|とくめい}{性|せい}: anonymity (as a quality/property)

CULTURAL NOTE:
Anonymous posting has been a defining feature of Japanese internet culture since early bulletin board systems like 2ちゃんねる. The default username {名無|ななし}しさん (lit. "Mr./Ms. No-Name") became iconic.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {匿名|とくめい}: anonymous (formal)
- {実名|じつめい}: real name (opposite — {実名|じつめい}で{投稿|とうこう}する = to post under one's real name)
